Early Alpha MVP

Welcome to HPL Ball Drop Alpha

This is a very early, very basic MVP built to test the economics, token utility, rewards, reflections, and full HPL gameplay loop.

Features, gameplay, rewards, balancing, and even how the game works can change at any time while we continue testing and building.

If you have questions, feedback, or spot something that does not seem right, please make sure you are part of the HPL Telegram community as we continue building the first MVP for the HPL Token ecosystem.
